name: Dumbbell Wrist Radial Deviation

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Wrist and Forearm Conditioning Program

steps: Sit with your forearm supported on a table or resting on your thigh, with your hand extending past the edge.
Hold a light dumbbell (1 to 3 lbs) with your thumb pointing straight up in a neutral 'hammer' position.
Keeping your forearm flat and still on the surface, lift your wrist upward toward the ceiling (in the direction of your thumb).
Hold for 1 second at the peak of radial deviation.
Slowly lower your wrist back to the neutral starting level under control.
coaching_cues: Keep your forearm anchored to the table; only your wrist moves.
Do not twist or rotate your forearm; keep the thumb pointing directly up.
Use very light weight to protect the delicate wrist tendons.

sources.attribution: AAOS Wrist and Forearm Conditioning Program
